SETTINGS.CONNECTION_HINT: Chatwoot reads the same web API the Mais Prático dashboard uses. Nothing from the ERP is stored here: it is a short-lived copy.
SETTINGS.BASE_URL_HINT: Only https on an inntegra.com.br address.
SETTINGS.COMPANIES_HINT: Comma separated, as in the ERP (e.g. somosemp, somosfilial). Only these are read and written.
SETTINGS.DEVICE_ID_HINT: The x-device-id header of a request from the ERP dashboard (DevTools > Network). Never shown again after saving.
SETTINGS.TEST_HINT: Saves what is on the screen, fetches the orders from the ERP and shows how many came.
SETTINGS.MIRROR_HINT: Period read from the ERP and how long everyone shares the same copy.
SETTINGS.ORDERS_HINT: Off: the service order board, the order list on contacts and deals, and order editing disappear. Only quotes stay. Orders are still read in the background only to find the ERP customer when linking a contact.
SETTINGS.WRITE_HINT: Lets people change the sub-status and the fields below on an existing order. Creating or deleting orders only in the desktop system.
SETTINGS.NOTE_ON_CHANGE: Log each change as a private note in the conversation
SETTINGS.EXTRA_FIELDS_HINT: Only add a field after changing it in the ERP itself with DevTools open and reading the endpoint name.
SETTINGS.SUBSTATUS_HINT: One per line. Empty: taken from the sub-statuses already used in each company's orders.
SETTINGS.ERP_USER_HINT: idUsuario written to the sub-status history when the person has none (the ERP dashboard uses 0).
SETTINGS.QUOTE_WRITE_HINT: The quote made in the chat is recorded in Mais Prático through the ERP's own functions (numbering, taxes and totals come from the ERP). Recording starts off.
SETTINGS.QUOTE_FORMA_PAGTO_HINT: The ERP's own list. Preselected on every new quote.
SETTINGS.INVALID: Check the fields marked in red.
SETTINGS.QUOTE_SERVICES_DIRECT: Record services directly in the quote
SETTINGS.QUOTE_SERVICES_DIRECT_HINT: The ERP function drops items without NCM, and services have none. When on, the service line is written directly with the same math as the function.
SETTINGS.QUOTE_DISCOUNT: Ask for approval when the discount is above the limit
SETTINGS.QUOTE_DISCOUNT_HINT: Somos's Mais Prático has no discount limit filled in. Above these limits, someone with discount permission in the ERP (or a manager) approves with their ERP code and password. 0 = any discount needs approval.
SETTINGS.QUOTE_DISCOUNT_LINE: Free discount per item up to (%)
SETTINGS.QUOTE_DISCOUNT_TOTAL: Free discount on the total up to (%)
SETTINGS.QUOTE_PLACEHOLDERS: Use {numero}, {contato}, {cliente}, {total}, {pagamento} and {vendedor}: they are replaced with the quote data.
SETTINGS.OS_PLACEHOLDERS: Use {numero}, {contato}, {cliente}, {tecnico} and {vendedor}: they are replaced with the service order data.
SETTINGS.NEXTCLOUD_HINT: The chat shows the invoice PDF stored on Nextcloud, found by its number ("3594 (6102) CUSTOMER.pdf"). Nothing is stored in the chat.
SETTINGS.NEXTCLOUD_PASSWORD_HINT: Create it in Nextcloud > Personal settings > Security > App passwords. Use a user that only sees the invoices folder.
SETTINGS.CLIENT_WRITE_HINT: Lets agents register customers in Mais Prático from the chat, through the ERP's own function. Customers are saved as pre-registrations, and an already registered CPF/CNPJ is never saved again. Off by default; who can use it is set in the access profile (Customer registration).

BLOCK.TITLE: Parts and services quotes (ERP)

LIST.EMPTY: No quotes yet. Use the button above to make the first one.

DRAWER.SUBMITTING_HINT: Recording in Mais Prático. You can close this: it keeps going and the list shows when it is done.

DRAWER.READ_ONLY: Draft by {user}. Only the creator or an administrator can change it.

DRAWER.SKIPPED: Left out of the quote: {items}. Check the product in Mais Prático (NCM for the customer state).
DRAWER.CONDITIONS_ERROR: The quote was recorded, but the other conditions (terms, warranty) were not. Check in Mais Prático.
DRAWER.REVISING_HINT: You are changing quote #{number}, which is already in Mais Prático. Saving replaces its items and terms there. Customer, payment and freight stay as they are.
